patterns: APPSC asks single-fact article numbers: Art. 153 (one Governor for 2+ States, 7th Amendment), 155 appointment, 164 CM appointment, 213 ordinance, 356 PR.
Statement-type traps: 'Governor quits immediately after term' (false), minimum age 35, max PR 3 years, never in Telangana/Chhattisgarh, reservation = central control.
AP angle: number of PR spells in AP (1973 Jai Andhra; Andhra State 1954-55), first Governor C.M. Trivedi.
App adds heavy 2025-26 case-law/current-affairs (TN v Governor, 16th Reference, TN hung House, WB) and long multi-statement items well beyond PYQ depth.
Other PSCs favour discretion lists (UPSC 2014: report under 356 + reservation of bills), immunity under Art. 361, ordinance approved by State Legislature.
